import json
def f(g):
    m=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x not in (0,2)]
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    rows=[r for r in range(len(g)) if any(g[r][c]==2 for c in range(len(g[0])))]
    cols=[c for c in range(len(g[0])) if any(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(len(g)))]
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows); c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        ms=[c for rr,c in m if rr==r]
        if any(c<c0 for c in ms) and not any(c>c1 for c in ms):
            rng=range(c1+1,C)
        elif any(c>c1 for c in ms) and not any(c<c0 for c in ms):
            rng=range(0,c0)
        else:
            rng=range(0,C)
        for c in rng: o[r][c]=2
    blocked={c for r,c in m if r>r1}
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if c in blocked: continue
        for r in range(r1+1,R): o[r][c]=2
    return o
out=f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(out==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
